cost_rule: Existing profiled assignment floors never decrease. Max of compatible complete totals and explicit incomplete extrapolation, times1.15. New unprofiled files replace generic fallback only with authenticated complete XML measurements. All original profile fields, sources and measurements retained.
extrapolation_method: PR whole-file total times max(1, main completion-log span / matching PR prefix total excluding first completion). Incomplete observations remain lower bounds; extrapolated totals are estimates, not completed measurements.15% allowance applied once.
job_overhead_method: Maximum complete PR/main job elapsed minus sum of total testcase durations, multiplied once by unchanged1.15. Includes collection, process/reporting and outside-step overhead once per job.

new_fixture_setup_estimate.basis: New explicit historical snapshot/guard setup absent from baseline. Initial Windows setup reached13.16s before missing-document rejection;30s allowance is separate from baseline measured phases. No historical measurement relabelled.

uncertainty: Same-tree runs vary materially. Incomplete prefix extrapolation and future source-binding overhead are uncertain; projected reserves are not runtime guarantees. No held-out execution evidence claimed.
